analysis.insight_summary: Users report that with the demo version of [product_name] [version_no] on MacOS, the Update Center only provides language pack updates rather than full updates or new features. There is notable confusion over update availability and feature support for demo versions on MacOS, alongside eagerness for the upcoming [version_no] and features like web server functionality. Several users highlight uncertainty regarding software parity and update timelines, especially on MacOS, and mention the possibility of restricted features in demo versions compared to the full software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect access to complete software updates, new versions (such as [version_no]), and previews of upcoming features, instead of being limited to language packs in the demo version on MacOS. They also anticipate consistent feature availability and updates across all platforms.
